title: Tattaunawar tallace-tallace, ƙin yarda da dawo da ƙararrakin

say: Tattaunawar tallace-tallace, ƙin yarda da dawo da ƙararrakin.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar 2 na Abokin Ciniki da Tallace-tallace.
Siyar da kyau ba batun magana mai wayo bane ko matsa lamba. Taɗi ne mai taimako tare da bayyananniyar alkibla.

say: Kuskuren gama gari shine rage farashin ku lokacin da wani ya faɗi tsada sosai. Yana koya wa abokan ciniki kullun turawa, kuma yana cinye ribarku. San farashin ku, farashin ku na yau da kullun da mafi ƙarancin farashin ku kafin farawa.

panel.rule: Kar a amsa farashi tare da rangwame nan take.

say: Ga hanyar da ke aiki. Funmi tana sayar da gyaran gashin kan layi daga Fatakwal.
Wata kwastomar ta ce bulonta mai inci 18 akan naira 45,000 yayi tsada sosai, domin ta ga daya akan 30,000.
Funmi ta yarda da damuwar, sannan ta fayyace: shin ɗayan gashin ɗan adam ne, kuma nauyi ɗaya? Abokin ciniki bai tabbata ba.
Funmi ta bayyana cewa nata 100% gashin mutum ne zaka iya wankewa da sake amfani da ita tsawon watanni.
Sannan ta ba ta inch 14 a cikin inganci iri ɗaya akan 36,000. Abokin ciniki ya zaɓi shi. Funmi ta canza kayan, ba gefenta ba.
Kowane kasuwanci yana samun gunaguni. Abin da zai yanke ko ta dawo shine yadda kuka yi. L, saurare. Bari ta yi cikakken bayani ba tare da katsewa ba.

panel.heading: Me za a ce maimakon
right: Bari in ga yadda zan iya gyara wannan
Na gode da aiko da hotunan

say: Ka ce maimakon haka, bari in ga yadda zan gyara muku wannan. Na gode da aiko da hotunan. Ina so in daidaita. Kuma amsa a cikin sa'a.
Idan ta yi kuka a cikin jama'a, ba da amsa sau ɗaya, a natse, kuma ta koma hira ta sirri.

say: Don tunawa. Bi matakai shida kowane lokaci. Ɗauki ƙin yarda a matsayin tambayoyi. Bayyana ƙima kafin farashi, kuma kada ku taɓa siyarwa a ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin farashin ku.
Kula da ƙararraki tare da LAST, kuma shigar da kowane ƙara don ku iya gyara dalilin.

say: Juyin ku. Rubuta tattaunawar tallace-tallace don samfurin ku mafi kyawun siyarwa. Rubuta martani ga ƙin yarda huɗu da kuka fi ji, tare da farashin ku, farashi na yau da kullun da mafi ƙarancin farashi. Rubuta amsa ta ƘARSHE ga ƙararraki ɗaya na gaske, kuma fara rajistan ƙararrakin ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
